t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup styled as a warm limestone paper drawing sheet with a thin navy border. Left: a large light-weight navy sans-serif headline stacked over several short lines. Centre: a boxed three-column table with navy outlines, a header row and row labels for <CONTENT>, every cell filled with short text. Right: a narrow margin strip of numbered note boxes, each with a small mono number tag in its corner, and a small title block at the bottom. Flat, square corners, no shading, calm and orderly.
signature_idea: A drawing sheet with a margin strip of numbered note boxes framing a boxed process table, like a form waiting to be filled.
strengths: limestone sheet and navy outlines are on-palette and calm
right-edge numbered strip is a clear drawing-sheet device that could hold notes
light headline is readable and on-brand
simple to build as a CSS grid
weaknesses: plain table only, no visual idea
two of three table columns are empty grids, so it reads unfinished
headline text is duplicated ('it it') and repeated in the title block
table outlines are heavier than hairlines
no mono figures, no accent, little hierarchy
brand_fit_why: Palette and light type fit, but it is an empty form with duplicated text and no idea, far from the brand's precise finish.
